title: Jesus... I Lost Money On A Betting App And Hid It From Everyone
topic: hiding betting app losses from his family

bible.text: He who conceals his sins will not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them will find mercy.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I lost my savings on a betting app. At dinner I laughed like nothing happened. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: One more win would fix it before anyone finds out.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: That thought is the trap. It's what took the money.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: If my father finds out, he'll never trust me again.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Hiding it is costing you more than money. Delete the app. Then tell him one true sentence.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Stop chasing it back. Let Me walk you out.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who keeps saying "one more win". 🙏
